prompt:
# Decorative prop d10183: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10183/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the symmetrical double silver crescent head, tall central part, short brown grip with gold bands, and small pale pointed pommel. Render one complete upright Sygnir on genuine transparent alpha without redesign or generic substitution. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): proportions like MM6-MM8 one-handed shaped metal head. The haft is long and slender: total height at least 2.4 times the width of the double crescent head, with the gold-banded grip and pale pommel at the bottom. Keep the design, only the haft is longer and the head relatively smaller..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the symmetrical double silver crescent head, tall central part, short brown grip with gold bands, and small pale pointed pommel. Render one complete upright Sygnir on genuine transparent alpha without redesign or generic substitution. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): proportions like MM6-MM8 one-handed shaped metal head. The haft is long and slender: total height at least 2.4 times the width of the double crescent head, with the gold-banded grip and pale pommel at the bottom. Keep the design, only the haft is longer and the head relatively smaller.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10183/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input roles: image 1 design_reference.png is detail reference; image 2 icon_x8.png is colour reference; image 3 paint_mask_guide.png is the exact edit target. Preserve image 3 geometry and layout exactly. The request for one upright item describes the item within its existing view, never replace the atlas with a single item. Produce the complete 3-column 4-row atlas.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The previous attempt had ragged mask silhouettes and stray speckles outside them. Use the original guide as a strict silhouette stencil: crisp clean contours, absolutely no pixels outside. Material masks must classify the wood haft as pure YELLOW #FFFF00, leather lower grip GREEN #00FF00, and only the blade head, steel fittings, gold grip bands and pommel RED #FF0000. Never make the entire weapon red. Paint must be flat unlit base color without bright specular highlights. Preserve all ten exact original guide silhouettes and positions.
limitations: Mask side views still classify wooden hafts as metal; stray edge pixels remain.
Paint contains highlights despite unlit request.
